title: An Exact Generate - Transform Decomposition of Small-LLM Team Scaling Across Orchestration Architectures
abstract: arXiv:2609.36104v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Replacing one LLM agent with a collaborating team can raise accuracy, but whether scaling the team helps, and which architecture to scale, is unclear. Sweeping eight agent orchestration architectures across five instruction-tuned 7-9B models, five short-answer benchmarks, and an executable-code benchmark up to 30 calls, we find that the returns to team scaling are sharply task-dependent: from three to thirty calls accuracy rises by up to 17 points on the two arithmetic word-problem benchmarks (GSM8K, GSMHard) but by at most four on ARC, GPQA, and MMLU, for every architecture, a split the usual task-averaged number conceals. Proposer-Critic captures the arithmetic gains, scaling steepest and, in aggregate, surpassing every other architecture at the largest budget (item-clustered intervals exclude zero), though it ranks among the weakest elsewhere, and no architecture wins across tasks. translated_title: 跨编排架构的小型LLM团队扩展的精确“生成-变换”分解
translated_abstract: 用一个协作团队替换单个LLM智能体可以提高准确率，但扩展团队是否有帮助、以及应该扩展哪种架构，目前仍不明确。我们在五个指令微调的7-9B模型、五个简答题基准测试以及一个可执行代码基准测试上，对八种智能体编排架构进行了系统扫描（调用次数最多达30次），发现团队扩展的收益高度依赖于任务：从三次调用扩展到三十次调用时，在两个算术应用题基准（GSM8K、GSMHard）上准确率最多可提升17个百分点，而在ARC、GPQA和MMLU上，所有架构的提升都不超过4个百分点——这一分化被通常使用的任务平均数值所掩盖。Proposer-Critic（提议者-批评者）架构捕获了算术任务的全部收益，其扩展曲线最为陡峭，并且在最大预算下总体上超越了所有其他架构（按项目聚类的置信区间不包含零），尽管它在其他任务中排名靠后，且没有任何架构能在所有任务上都获胜。我们用一个精确的生成……（原文摘要在此截断）
tldr: 该研究发现小型LLM团队扩展的收益高度依赖任务类型——在算术应用题上最多可提升17个百分点而在ARC、GPQA、MMLU等任务上最多仅4个百分点，并提出精确的“生成-变换”分解来解释这一现象，其中Proposer-Critic架构在算术任务上扩展收益最陡峭，但没有任何编排架构能在所有任务上普遍获胜。
en_tdlr: This study finds that returns to scaling small-LLM agent teams are sharply task-dependent—up to 17 points on arithmetic word-problem benchmarks versus at most 4 on ARC/GPQA/MMLU—and explains these trajectories with an exact generate-transform decomposition, showing Proposer-Critic scales steepest on arithmetic tasks while no single orchestration architecture wins across all tasks.
